# ggsegHO

Harvard-Oxford cortical and subcortical atlases for the ggseg ecosystem.
Includes the original Harvard-Oxford atlas (FSL) and the Harvard-Oxford
Atlas 2.0 (HOA-2).

## Installation

We recommend installing the ggseg-atlases through the ggseg
[r-universe](https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev/#builds):

``` r

options(repos = c(
  ggsegverse = "https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))

install.packages("ggsegHO")
```

You can install this package from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ggsegverse/ggsegHO")
```

## Harvard-Oxford cortical

``` r

library(ggseg)
library(ggsegHO)

plot(ho_cort())
```

![](reference/figures/README-ho-cort-1.png)

## Harvard-Oxford subcortical

``` r

plot(ho_sub())
```

![](reference/figures/README-ho-sub-1.png)

## HOA-2 cortical

``` r

plot(ho2_cort())
```

![](reference/figures/README-ho2-cort-1.png)

## HOA-2 subcortical

The deep grey structures, the brain-stem, and the cerebellum split into
grey and white matter — HOA-2 segments the cerebellum by tissue rather
than parcellating it, so those structures belong here.

``` r

plot(ho2_sub())
```

![](reference/figures/README-ho2-sub-1.png)

## Data source

Makris N, et al. (2006). Decreased volume of left and total anterior
insular lobule in schizophrenia. *Schizophrenia Research*,
83(2-3):155-171.
[doi:10.1016/j.schres.2005.11.020](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.schres.2005.11.020)

Rushmore RJ, et al. (2022). HOA2.0-ComPaRe: A next generation
Harvard-Oxford Atlas. *Frontiers in Neuroanatomy*, 16:1035420.

# Package index

## Atlases

Brain atlases bundled in this package

- [`ho2_cort()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ho2_cort.md)
  : Harvard-Oxford Atlas 2.0 Cortical
- [`ho2_sub()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ho2_sub.md)
  : Harvard-Oxford Atlas 2.0 Subcortical
- [`ho_cort()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ho_cort.md)
  : Harvard-Oxford Cortical Atlas
- [`ho_sub()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ho_sub.md)
  : Harvard-Oxford Subcortical Atlas

## Deprecated

Former names, kept working for one release cycle

- [`hoCort()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ggsegHO-deprecated.md)
  [`hoSub()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegHO/reference/ggsegHO-deprecated.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Atlases renamed to snake_case
